source.title: Pathfinder Society Scenario #2-09: The Seven Secrets of Dacilane Academy

notes.saves: +2 circumstance to all saves vs. disease

items.name: +2 Status to All Saves vs. Disease
Feign Death
items.text:
Trigger The opossum is reduced below 15 HP

---

Effect The opossum collapses. It is Off-Guard and can use actions that require only its mind, but any other action ends the ruse. A successful DC 16 Perception check check to Seek or DC 16 Medicine check check to Recall Knowledge is required to determine that the animal is not, in fact, dead.

items.name: Revived Retaliation
items.text:
Trigger The opossum is attacked or disturbed by a creature within reach while Feigning Death

---

Effect The opossum Strikes the triggering creature.

items.name: Scurry Underfoot
items.text: The opossum Strides up to half its speed. It can pass through other creatures' spaces during this movement, though it must end its movement in an unoccupied space.
